definitions.gloss: what, what matter, what on earth
definitions.explanation: Used to ask or express surprise about what is happening. More formal or dramatic than simply なに.
Used with も to mean 'everything' or 'anything,' often in the context of approaching all things with a certain attitude.

examples.japanese: {何事|なにごと}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I wondered what was going on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧がして、{何事|なにごと}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: There was a loud noise outside, so I opened the window to see what was happening.

examples.japanese: {何事|なにごと}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}った→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧。
examples.english: He acted as if nothing had happened.

examples.japanese: {何事|なにごと}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧だ。
{何事|なにごと}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{肝心|かんじん}→肝心：21541_kanjin⟧だ。
examples.english: In everything, the beginning is crucial.

examples.japanese: {何事|なにごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}む→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The attitude of giving your all in everything is important.

notes:
{何事|なにごと} is a more formal and dramatic way of saying "what" (⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧). It also means "everything/anything" when paired with ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧.

SENSE 1 — WHAT (SURPRISE/ALARM):
- {何事|なにごと}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧: to wonder what is going on
- {何事|なにごと}だ: What's happening? / What is this?
- {何事|なにごと}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as if nothing had happened (very common set phrase)

SENSE 2 — EVERYTHING/ANYTHING:
- {何事|なにごと}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧だ: everything is an experience
- {何事|なにごと}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{肝心|かんじん}→肝心：21541_kanjin⟧: in everything, the start is crucial
- {何事|なにごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: with full effort in everything

REGISTER:
More literary and elevated than plain ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧. Conveys gravity, importance, or philosophical tone. Common in proverbs, speeches, and narrative writing.

FORMS:
⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧ (what) + {事|こと} (matter, thing). The combination creates a weightier word than either part alone.
